mapper.update: UPDATE repair_worker SET work_status=#{workStatus} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE repair_worker SET work_status=#{workStatus} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND work_status=#{expectedStatus}
UPDATE repair_worker SET worker_no=#{workerNo},remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT w.id workerId,w.user_id userId,u.username,u.real_name realName,u.phone,w.worker_no workerNo,u.status userStatus,w.work_status workStatus,w.remark FROM repair_worker w JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE w.id=#{id} AND w.deleted=0 AND u.deleted=0

SELECT DISTINCT w.id workerId,w.user_id userId,u.username,u.real_name realName,u.phone,w.worker_no workerNo,u.status userStatus,w.work_status workStatus,w.remark FROM repair_worker w JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=w.user_id JOIN repair_worker_fault_type wf ON wf.worker_id=w.id AND wf.status=1 WHERE w.deleted=0 AND u.deleted=0 AND w.worker_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{workerNo},'%') AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{realName},'%') AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{phone},'%') AND w.work_status=#{workStatus} AND wf.fault_type_id=#{faultTypeId} ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT w.id workerId,COALESCE(loads.workload,0) workload FROM repair_worker w JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=w.user_id AND u.deleted=0 AND u.status=1 JOIN repair_worker_fault_type wf ON wf.worker_id=w.id AND wf.status=1 AND wf.fault_type_id=#{faultTypeId} JOIN repair_worker_area_scope s ON s.worker_id=w.id AND s.status=1 AND s.campus_id=#{campusId} AND (s.area_id IS NULL OR s.area_id=#{areaId}) AND (s.building_id IS NULL OR s.building_id=#{buildingId}) LEFT JOIN (SELECT current_assignee_id,COUNT(*) workload FROM repair_order WHERE deleted=0 AND status IN (1,2,3,4,5) GROUP BY current_assignee_id) loads ON loads.current_assignee_id=w.id WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.work_status=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repair_leave_request l WHERE l.worker_id=w.id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.status=1 AND l.start_time<=#{now} AND l.end_time>=#{now})
GROUP BY w.id,loads.workload ORDER BY workload ASC,w.id ASC
